summary:

detailed_description:
During live on-screen dialogue, keep the current speaker visually dominant and addressing the actual listener: the speaker's eyes target the listener's eye line, and the head, mouth projection, and natural upper-body orientation point toward that listener without forcing a rigid full-body frontal pose. The camera is an observer, never the conversational target. Unless the script explicitly calls for direct-to-camera speech, the speaker must not look into the lens, look past the listener toward an unrelated direction, or speak toward empty space. When the addressee changes, show a story-supported gaze or body turn before changing the facing direction. VO/OS may remain off-screen; when the voiceover character is visible, use the exact VO sentence form required below and keep the character silent on screen, lips completely closed, with no lip-sync or speaking gesture. Only verbal content inside <d> blocks is spoken. Every camera move must carry new information; no aimless drift. No background music; audio-only dialogue; no subtitles, overlays or unapproved text. Control tags are never visible. Keep every frame clean and text-free.

[Shot 1] <Subject 1> 程望山 riding <Subject 5> 快递电动车 in <Subject 3> 学校门口: 程望山 rides along the right side of the road approaching from distance, both hands on handlebars, body slightly forward, <Subject 4> 黑色SUV parked diagonally ahead at zebra crossing blocking his line of sight, students streaming out from school gate in background. Medium shot, low camera position at scooter seat height, leading side-front tracking angle; 35mm at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, focus on 程望山 and scooter. Daytime afternoon natural light, 5200K warm side sunlight from right-rear, long shadows on asphalt, SUV body has specular highlights. Trigger: school bell rings and crowd surges out. D3 leading tracking shot: camera moves ahead of scooter at ~1.5x subject speed, hard acceleration from 00:00.000 then sustained high speed, dolly forward ~3 meters over 2.4 seconds, subject screen height 30%→55%, foreground students rushing past with strong parallax, hard stop at 00:02.400 as scooter decelerates. Composition: scooter on left third, SUV on right third creating visual obstruction, school gate centered in background, axis side: camera on right side of road relative to travel direction. 程望山's expression shifts from daily calm to mild alertness — brows draw slightly together, eyes scanning ahead past the SUV, no dialogue in this shot. SFX: school bell from distant gate direction at 00:00.000, crowd murmur building, electric scooter motor sound approaching from distance and increasing; no new dialogue. End state: scooter approaching SUV blind spot, 程望山 still riding, both hands on handlebars. Duration: 2.4 seconds.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.400, cut to close-up from side low angle; 50mm at f/2.0, extremely shallow depth of field, focus racking from 大爷's feet to 程望山's face. Local lighting: afternoon side light, 大爷's face fully lit, 程望山's face half-lit half-shadowed. Trigger: 大爷 steps out from SUV blind spot and 程望山 shouts warning. D3 rapid pan + push-in: camera pans horizontally ~45° from 大爷's feet up to 程望山's face while simultaneously surging forward, completing the push in 0.8 seconds, dolly forward ~1.5 meters, subject screen height 35%→70%, hard stop at the warning line's endpoint. Composition: 大爷 on right stepping into lane, scooter approaching from left foreground, 程望山 leaning forward with right hand on brake and left hand pointing toward curb; axis maintained on same side. 程望山's expression: burst-level — eyes wide open, mouth opening on the shout, pupils contracted, facial muscles tight. <Subject 1> (S1), 程望山, uses established voice — mid-40s male, chesty working-man timbre, slight vocal roughness, Mandarin with neutral accent, breath support from diaphragm. This line is an urgent warning shouted from the diaphragm, volume spikes suddenly, pace 5.5 chars/sec, hard sharp consonants, ending bursting on the final word. Says: <d>大爷，退回去！</d> SFX: sharp tire screech from locked rear brake starting at 00:02.600 synchronized with brake lever squeeze, vegetable basket rattling. End state: 程望山 mid-shout, right hand squeezing brake, scooter beginning to skid. Duration: 2.4 seconds.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.800, cut to medium-wide shot from oblique low angle; 28mm at f/4.0, medium depth of field, focus on scooter and 程望山's leap trajectory. Local lighting: afternoon side-backlight rim-lighting both figures, thin tire smoke visible on asphalt. Trigger: rear wheel locks and scooter drifts, 程望山 jumps off. D3 pan + tracking: camera pans horizontally ~45° following the rear wheel's drift direction while tracking 程望山's leap trajectory, trucking ~2 meters left-to-right and dollying ~1 meter forward over 2.8 seconds, subject screen height 40%→60%, stabilizing as he pushes 大爷. Composition: scooter drifting diagonally from left toward SUV on right, rear wheel swinging out, 程望山 leaping from seat toward 大爷 at center-right, 大爷 being pushed toward curb at far right; spatial continuity preserved, no character repositioning. 程望山's action: body launches off seat in one fluid motion, both arms extend forward, palms strike 大爷's chest pushing him back onto curb, expression intense — brows locked deep, mouth corners pulled tight, no dialogue. SFX: sustained tire screech, body drift friction sound, clothing wind rush during leap at 00:05.800, dull body impact thud as hands contact 大爷 at 00:06.800. End state: 大爷 pushed onto curb, 程望山 mid-fall from momentum, scooter still sliding toward SUV. Duration: 2.8 seconds.

[Shot 4] At 00:07.600, cut to extreme close-up at impact point; 85mm at f/1.8, extremely shallow depth of field, focus on SUV left front door. Local lighting: afternoon natural light, metal impact point has bright specular highlight, shattered glass catches light. Trigger: scooter impacts SUV. D3 rapid push-in then hard static: camera surges forward ~1 meter in 0.5 seconds before impact, subject screen height 50%→85%, then hard static for 1.2 seconds to read the damage clearly — evidence stop per gate 3. Composition: SUV left door centered, scooter handlebar entering from left, mirror shattering toward right, packages spilling from rear box at lower-left, vegetable basket tipping; all on same spatial plane. Pure prop action chain in physical inertia order: handlebar shatters mirror → body slams door → door dents → rear box latch breaks → packages scatter → basket tips vegetables roll. SFX: mirror shattering glass spray at 00:07.800, dull metal impact thud at 00:08.000, rear box latch snap, packages cascading rustle at 00:08.400, basket tipping and vegetables rolling. End state: SUV left door visibly dented, mirror broken, packages and vegetables scattered on asphalt. Duration: 2.6 seconds.

[Shot 5] At 00:10.200, cut to medium close-up from curb side; 50mm at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, focus on both 程望山 and 大爷. Local lighting: afternoon warm light from right, sweat sheen on 程望山's forehead, forehead bruise visible. Trigger: 程望山 falls sitting and 大爷 recovers to speak. D3 slow tilt-down + gentle push-in: camera tilts down ~0.8 meters from fall action to both faces while gently pushing forward ~0.5 meters over 4 seconds, subject screen height 45%→65%, stabilizing at 大爷's line endpoint. Composition: 程望山 sitting on curb at left facing 大爷 at right, 大爷 standing on curb slightly bent forward, distance ~1.5 meters, camera on same axis side as previous shots. 程望山: stumbles and falls sitting from momentum, right knee scrapes ground (no injury), right hand braces on ground, left hand touches forehead bruise, ignores own injury to check on 大爷 first — expression shifts from moderate tension (brows firmly drawn, lips pressed) to mild relief as he confirms 大爷 is okay. 大爷: braces knees catching breath, first raises right hand to signal he is unhurt, then points at 程望山's forehead — expression mild (eye rims slightly red, lips trembling slightly). <Subject 2> (S2), 大爷, uses established voice — 70s male, thin reedy timbre, weak breath support, slight regional accent, slow deliberate articulation. This line is weak and breathless, voice thin and unsteady, low volume, trembling on sustained vowels, frequent shallow breaths, pace 3 chars/sec, deliberate pause at opening, ending fading to a breath. Says: <d>小伙子……我没事！你、你额头撞肿了！</d> SFX: knee scraping ground at 00:10.300 synchronized with fall, distant package rolling sounds continuing as ambience. End state: 程望山 sitting on curb facing 大爷, left hand at forehead bruise, 大爷 pointing at his forehead, both in dialogue. Duration: 4.0 seconds.
